title: Part Sixteen: Rome and Zionism I: Herzl to the War, 1904–1945

sections.brief: The Latin presence in Ottoman Palestine (Custody, Latin Patriarchate 1847, French protection); Herzl's meeting with Merry del Val (22 January 1904, per Minerbi) and audience with Pius X (25 January; diary of 26 January), quoted from Herzl's own record and graded as one party's account; the political and theological refusals kept apart; scholarship (Minerbi, Kreutz, Ferrari, Bialer). Figures: fig-compare (two kinds of answer)

Sokolow's audience with Benedict XV (4 or 6 May 1917; known from Sokolow's report; disputed words); the reaction to Balfour (Gasparri, the pope, December 1917); allocutions of 10 March 1919 (primary) and 13 June 1921; Gasparri's notes to the League against the draft Mandate (6 March / 15 May / 4 June 1922, dates differ); Mandate Arts. 4, 13, 14; Barlassina, Muslim-Christian Associations, Valeri 1929, Peel 1937, White Paper 1939. Figures: fig-time (1917–1939 with strength)

The 1943 private record: Tardini, Maglione to Cicognani and Godfrey, Roncalli (ADSS, released January 1976), Cicognani to Myron Taylor 22 June 1943 in full; Shertok 10 April 1945; Pave the Way's claimed 1944 note graded unverified; Holocaust record linked to vt14_pius_files, not repeated. Figures: fig-time (1943–1945), fig-compare (refusal record vs evidence offered for a front)
